build_svm_classifier: build an SVM classifier using BaseLibSVM with linear or rbf kernel for multi-class classification
fit_svm_model: fit a LibSVM-based estimator on training data with sample weights and custom kernel
predict_class_labels: predict class labels from fitted SVM classifier using dense or sparse input data
compute_decision_function: compute decision function values for samples to measure distance from separating hyperplane
fit_liblinear_model: fit a linear model using liblinear with configurable loss, penalty, and dual formulation
